prose.name: Salvage: Militia Clasp on <Planet>
prose.briefing: A salvager's note says he left a militia clasp at the <SecondPlace> and never went back for it. Something has nested there since.

message.title: Militia Clasp
message.text: The stash is under the nest debris, intact. The name on the clasp is scratched away, but the militia number is not, and the roster lists a brother at the <Place>.

beats.objective: Return the clasp to his brother
beats.journal: I dug a militia clasp out of an infested stash and took it to the soldier's brother at the <Place>.

message.title: Returned
message.text: His brother holds it up to the light to read the number, then pins it to his own jacket. He pays what he can.

beats.name: Family Shrine

beats.objective: Sell the clasp to the militia post
beats.journal: I dug a militia clasp out of an infested stash and sold it to a militia post for their case of honours.

message.title: Sold
message.text: The quartermaster pays in full and sets it in the case by the door, between two others with the same unit number.

beats.name: Unit Footlocker

offer.journal: The clasp's militia number matches a soldier whose brother lives at the <Place>. A militia post wants it for their case of honours and will pay more than he can. It's my call.

message.title: Incoming Message
message.text: Heard you pulled a militia clasp out of that nest. Our post keeps the old unit's honours in a case by the door, for the new ones to read. I'm at the <ThirdPlace>. I'll pay more than his brother can. - Post Quartermaster
